fields.name: Subhash Mishra
fields.bio: With over 28 years of distinguished courtroom practice, Adv. Subhash Mishra is widely recognized for his authoritative advocacy across Constitutional Law, Corporate Dispute Resolution, and high-stakes Civil Appeals before the High Court of Madhya Pradesh and the Supreme Court of India. He has served as special counsel to statutory bodies and multinational corporations in landmark regulatory litigations.

fields.name: Vikramaditya Sharma
fields.bio: Specializing in Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC) proceedings and corporate restructurings, Adv. Vikramaditya Sharma represents financial institutions and resolution applicants across NCLT benches nationwide.

fields.name: Ananya Deshmukh
fields.bio: Ananya leads the chambers' arbitration desk, holding extensive experience in SIAC and domestic ad-hoc commercial dispute resolutions, construction claims, and concession disputes.

fields.name: Rohan Vardhan
fields.designation: Senior Associate — Real Estate & Civil Litigation
fields.bio: Rohan brings ten years of focused practice in real estate title verifications, RERA enforcement petitions, and original side civil property litigation before district and appellate courts.

fields.name: Pooja Verma
fields.bio: Pooja advises technology and manufacturing clients on trademark opposition, patent drafting, and antitrust compliance before the Competition Commission of India.

fields.name: Arjun Pratap Singh
fields.designation: Associate — Criminal Trial & White Collar Defense
fields.bio: Arjun focuses on economic offenses defense, PMLA investigations, and trial advocacy before Special CBI and Sessions Courts.
